description: 臺中市政府人行道固定設施-樹穴-大肚區 [cycling and walking networks] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府建設局. 臺中市政府人行道固定設施-樹穴-大肚區資料集提供了大肚區內人行道設施的樹穴資訊，包含設施位置、類型、狀態等詳細資訊。 這些資料可幫助市民了解大肚區內的公共設施，進而促進市民的出行安全和舒適度。 同時，這些資料也可供政府單位和相關機構進行公共設施的規劃和維護工作，從而提高公共設施的使用效率和安全性。. Coverage: 臺中市政府建設局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府建設局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
